scenario.name: r-cd-model-token
scenario.description: continue_delegate bracket/token form parses and forwards model=<provider/model> to the delegate child.
scenario.notes: Requires a seat/session surface where final bracket text is scanned; message-body seats may be HONEST_LIMIT by declared seat class.

invocation.tokenTemplate: [[CONTINUE_DELEGATE: Proof nonce {{nonce}}: report observed provider/model and nonce only. Do not mutate files. | silent-wake | model=${OPENCLAW_ALT_MODEL:-github-copilot/goldeneye}]]

expectedReceipts.name: dispatch-accepted
expectedReceipts.description: Gateway accepted the parent request that asks the agent to call continue_delegate for this model row

expectedReceipts.name: child-session-observed
expectedReceipts.description: A nonce-correlated delegate child session/run is observed on the subscribed session stream or session history

expectedReceipts.name: child-model-byte
expectedReceipts.description: Observed child runtime model/provider byte from status/session metadata or child self-report backed by session metadata

expectedReceipts.name: return-payload
expectedReceipts.description: Delegate return includes the row nonce and observed model/provider summary

expectedReceipts.name: trace-or-session-correlation
expectedReceipts.description: Trace id, span tree, or session-event correlation tying dispatch to child and return

expectedReceipts.name: bracket-parse-origin
expectedReceipts.description: Journal/session evidence that the delegate originated from bracket-token parsing with model modifier present

review.notes: PASS-candidate only when bracket parse origin, requested model, and observed child model all match. Declare seat-class before firing; do not retro-justify scanner suppression.
